title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 10 — WORLD 4: C2 RHETORIC, INFLUENCE & STRATEGIC COMMUNICATION
grammar: Rhetorical questions, parallelism, antithesis, and controlled repetition
Advanced modality, evidentiality, and degrees of certainty
Concession, contrast, and multi-layered argument structure
Information packaging through clefts, inversion, and marked word order
Nominalisation, dense modification, and concise formal prose
Hedging, boosting, attribution, and responsible claims
Pragmatic force, politeness, implicature, and strategic tone
